annihilation_reactor.title: Annihilation Reactor
texts: Day 12. Converts mass entirely into energy, E = mc^2, regulated by dilithium crystals. Nothing more efficient exists.$(br2)Generates power.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.

When a particle meets its antiparticle, both vanish and all of their rest mass becomes energy - mostly gamma rays, via E = mc^2. Fission releases under 0.1% of the mass; annihilation releases 100%. One gram of antimatter matches dozens of kilotons of TNT.

Fuel log: it burns $(item)Antimatter Pellets$() (with a $(item)Dilithium Crystal$() as regulator) at 131,072 FE/t, or a full $(item)Annihilation Core$() at 524,288 FE/t.$(br2)It needs superfluid helium cooling. Do not skip this.
Traps the ghost particles that pass through planets without noticing. Trillions cross my hand each second, and now I can keep some.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.

Neutrinos are near-massless leptons that feel only the weak force (and gravity). A light-year of lead would stop only about half of them. Real detectors use kilotons of water or ice and catch a handful a day. The $(item)Neutrino Condenser$() is, frankly, cheating.
Recreates the crushing interior of a collapsed star: neutronium, metallic hydrogen and quark matter. Each one a state of matter no lab on Earth has held.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 4$() machine.
Note to self: this controller is too complex for a crafting grid. It has to be built on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts before ordering anything.

Why it matters: a neutron star packs more than a Sun's mass into a city-sized sphere. Gravity crushes electrons into protons, leaving neutrons held up only by degeneracy pressure. Deeper in, neutrons may dissolve into free quarks. A teaspoon would weigh about a billion tonnes.
